answer: Each account must carve one quartz sundial on a registered glacier at the zenith hour. The carver sets the quartz dial into the ice, marks the noon shadow, and signs the carving record with the dial serial mark. Two verifiers check the record against the glacier register within a week, and a record tied to a second account voids both claims. The quartz and carving cost 3,000,000 rupiah, so 1,000 fake identities would spend 3,000,000,000 rupiah.
